run_remote_benchmark: run a remote benchmark across multiple hosts with specified bench and node parameters
install_testbed: install rust dependencies and clone the repo on all remote testbed nodes
kill_remote_nodes: kill running processes and optionally delete logs on specified remote hosts
select_hosts_for_benchmark: select remote hosts for benchmarking based on collocate mode and node count
generate_and_upload_config: generate configuration files and upload them to selected remote hosts
